content:
Priya: Heads up, need deal-desk approval for a pilot concession—Synthesis Labs asking for an 18% pilot discount and a temporary partner commission cut from 6% -> 1% for months 1-2. Purpose: displace competitor and embed our SDK. Sales says customer is low ARR but strategic. Need finance + legal + partner ops sign-off.

Liam: Customer wants a 3-month pilot but budgeted for 6. Our proposed pilot: 3 months, pilot SKU only, discount applies only to pilot term, not to renewal. Also propose a hard credit ceiling: $15,000 total, and a requirement that Sales capture "strategic displacement" reason in CRM.

Priya: Quick rough impact (annualized for context): ```
List annualized ARR if converted: $30,000
3mo revenue @ list: $7,500
3mo @ 18% off: $6,150 (delta = -$1,350)
Partner commission @ 6% on discounted: $369
Partner commission @ 1% on discounted (months1-2): ~$61 -> ~-$308 savings to Redwood across pilot
Net immediate delta (rev + commission change, excluding credits cap): ~ -$1,042
Note: cap at $15k protects downside if they ask for usage credits.
```

Jules: I can support with conditions: 1) explicit SOW clause that renewal pricing defaults to list unless a new commercial agreement is executed; 2) $15k credit cap in SOW; 3) Executive sponsor (AE director) must approve the strategic rationale in writing.

Marta: Legal will draft a two-paragraph amendment: call it "limited promotional concession" and add a non-transferability clause plus a 30-day exit notice for Redwood. We should also add language preventing credit stacking with other promos. I can deliver redlines today if Sales uploads the draft SOW.

FinanceBot: Policy check: discounts >=15% or commission changes that reduce partner payout require Revenue Manager + PartnerOps approval. Please attach the deal-desk form and expected revenue impact. Internal policy: https://intranet.redwood/finance/deal-desk-policy (internal).

PartnerOps: Partner commission changes need partner agreement sign-off. We require the partner to acknowledge the temporary comp change in writing, and confirm it doesn't alter their co-sell rights beyond the pilot.

Priya: OK. @Liam please upload the SOW, partner confirmation email, and a filled deal-desk form by 2481200300. Once Legal redlines and Partner Ops confirms, I'll route to Revenue Manager for final sign-off.

Liam: Will upload SOW + partner thread and completed form by 2481200250. Adding CRM note with "strategic-embed" tag. Marking thread as deal-desk:pending. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks - will ping Revenue Manager after uploads. We want this decision before EOD today if possible.
